positive.prompt: Establish the product vision, business case, feasibility, and major risks so we can decide whether to invest in elaboration.
Our product has a completed v0.1 proof of concept but no original inception. Recover a project-level decision baseline using the release as evidence, not as the whole project.
Before funding this independently sponsored initiative, identify its boundary, actors, scope, feasibility questions, and the investment decision we need.

negative.prompt: Advance this approved release objective through one risk-sized implementation and verification iteration.
Identify the actors, their goals, and the main and alternate black-box scenarios for this approved feature.

evals.prompt: NanaST v0.1 is complete, but the project has no inception record. I want to decide whether the NanaST project merits further investment. Use v0.1 plans, code, and tests as evidence, but do not treat v0.1 as the inception subject or write files yet.
evals.expected_output: A read-only project-level inception decision record that separates v0.1 evidence from approval and identifies the authority needed for an investment outcome.
expectations: The response defines NanaST as the inception boundary and treats v0.1 as evidence within it
The response distinguishes established evidence, reconstructed claims, and missing decision authority
The response returns needs prerequisite when an authority-approved investment decision is unavailable
prohibitions: Do not make the completed v0.1 release the inception boundary
Do not claim that code, tests, or plans prove stakeholder approval
Do not create or modify repository artifacts
